title: BP-TD: code and cached data for "Where Is the Truth When AI Agents Disagree? Dependence-Aware Belief Propagation for Unsupervised Truth Discovery" (IEEE BigData 2026)
description:
Code and cached agent answers for the paper Where Is the Truth When AI Agents Disagree? Dependence-Aware Belief Propagation for Unsupervised Truth Discovery by Laure Berti-Equille, accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData 2026), short paper.

BP-TD infers the true answers of disagreeing LLM agents and each agent's reliability without labels, using mean-field variational inference on a one-coin Dawid-Skene model with per-agent decorrelation weights (from base-model provenance or answer co-occurrence). Every number in the paper recomputes on CPU from the bundled answers; the result CSVs behind the paper are included.

Extended version of the paper: arXiv:2611.04805, https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2611.04805

Source repository: https://github.com/LaureBerti/BPTD
notes: Paper accepted at IEEE BigData 2026. Add the proceedings DOI as a related identifier (relation: isSupplementTo) once it is assigned.
